## LinkedIn (Long-form)

### Announcement Post

**Calmer conversations when the stakes are high**

I'm excited to share Access To Peace — a free, open-source AI tool for mediators, co-parents, and restorative practitioners.

Here's the problem: Trauma-informed conflict resolution, mediation, co-parenting de-escalation, and restorative practice navigation. But navigating this space is complex, and most people don't have a specialist by their side.

Access To Peace changes that. It's a Claude Skill — upload one file to Claude, and it becomes your peace expert. No code, no cost.

What you can do:
1. Route a conflict to the right module through an 80-trigger intake with a safety gate
2. Prepare a co-parent for a de-escalated exchange or a mediation session
3. Plan a restorative practice circle for a school or community group

It's part of the Access To ecosystem — 15 pillars, 18 projects, 15 of them open source.

Try it: github.com/dougdevitre/access-to-peace
Learn more: https://dougdevitre.org

#AccessTo #CivicTech #AI #OpenSource #Peace
